strengths: A new line on the hero piece. 'Watercolour, set in stone.' works twice: watercolour made permanent, and stones in their setting. 'cubic zirconia, not paint.' follows the winner's correction ('cubic zirconia, not candy.'). It hits the data's levers: Prism at ₹2,399 and in stock (68), a craft-material visual rhyme (a wash in the stones' three colours, with the bracelet laid along it), a light ivory ground, Feed 4:5. Every claim is a listing fact, and the idea reads at 390 px.

The crop rescue works. The plate is a native, unscaled crop of the failed P10_a1 frame at [330, 200, 1330, 1977] (template match 0.99999), so r1's three failures are out of frame. Both clasp ends (x about 196-260 and 1590-1650 in the source) are gone, the brush tip ends 30 px past the crop's right edge, and the strip runs off both sides. In frame: an aqua sliver, seven full units (P Y A P Y A P) and 82% of a yellow one, pitch 123 plate px. No same-colour neighbours. Cushion stones sit in two-row pavé halos (closer to listing-7 than P01's three frosted rows), with four bead claws, link bars and silver metal. The soft referents agree with true scale: at the real 8.4 mm pitch the sheet is about 86 mm tall, the wash about 6 cm deep and the paper grain under 1 mm.

The cleanest copy ground of the Prism set, with no glow or band. Headline 15.8:1 (darkest 5% 15.2), correction 16.4:1 (16.0), spec 12.3:1 (11.2), price 13.3:1 (12.2). The ink wordmark reads 13.6:1 (12.4), 179 px wide, 43 px above the price, its top level with the rule's (4 px). The copy ends at y 309, 450 px above the stones, and the halos end 291 px above the foot. 64 px margins.
issues: [placement] The sheet's deckled top edge (a faint highlight and a step from the pink backdrop to the cream paper, y 206-212) runs through the foot of 'SET IN STONE.' (caps y 156-227), 14-20 px above the baseline. At 390 px the headline looks as if it stands on a shelf.

[ceiling: photo] A generated frame, and the stones are the punchline. At 1:1 the yellow and pink stones carry a radial starburst texture instead of the listing's brilliant facets, where P01_a1's are crisp. The pinks lean mauve (hue -4 to -11°, saturation 0.21-0.24, against 1° and 0.17 on listing-7). The order is a strict A-P-Y repeat where the real piece is irregular, with no same-colour neighbours either way. None of it shows at 390 px. Ceiling 9.5.

[placement] A new line, not a new picture. It is P01_a1's mechanic ('Rangoli, in a line.', 10): the bracelet as a straight horizontal line across aqua, pink and yellow on ivory, top-down, in the same layout and foot. Only the medium (a wash rather than powder bands), the line and the scale differ (units 123 px against P01_a1's 92). At 390 px the two read as siblings, and in one ad set they would compete for the same audience.
